_comment: The document versions the client ships, mirrored here so the server can be
checked without a second checkout. The Unity repository is the source of
truth: each value is the Version line of the corresponding file under
Updating a legal document means changing three things together - the
document, this manifest, and the published web page. scripts/verify-legal-versions.mjs
compares this against the real Unity documents and is a release step, not a
unit test, because it needs both checkouts.
